Film and television actress who rose to fame for her portrayal of Laura Chant in the 2017 film The Changeover. Just prior to her big screen debut, she made an appearance on the TV series Lucy Lewis Can't Lose.
Before Fame
She studied sociology at Victoria University.
Trivia
In 2013, she made an uncredited appearance in The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug.
Family Life
She is from New Zealand where she grew up on her grandparent's avocado farm.
Associated With
She was cast in the film adaptation of Margaret Mahy's The Changeover.
